records.title: UAT-PROBE Solid Waste Management Ordinance
records.content: An ordinance establishing a comprehensive solid waste management program for the Municipality of Pitogo, amending Ordinance No. 9902, S. 2091, and providing funds thereof. Section 1. All households shall segregate waste into biodegradable, non-biodegradable, and recyclable categories. Section 2. A materials recovery facility shall be established in each barangay.

records.title: UAT-PROBE Tricycle Registration Ordinance
records.content: An ordinance providing for the registration and regulation of tricycles operating within the Municipality of Pitogo, repealing Ordinance No. 9901, S. 2090, and appropriating funds therefor. Section 1. All tricycles must be registered with the Municipal Transportation Office. Section 2. Annual registration fees shall be set at five hundred pesos.
records.summary: This ordinance requires all tricycles in Pitogo to register annually with the Municipal Transportation Office for a fee of 500 pesos, replacing the previous registration rule. It applies to all tricycle operators in the municipality. [UAT-PROBE edited]

records.title: UAT-PROBE Fire Safety Ordinance
records.content: An ordinance establishing fire safety regulations for all establishments within the Municipality of Pitogo. Section 1. All commercial establishments shall maintain functional fire extinguishers. Section 2. Annual fire safety inspections shall be conducted by the Bureau of Fire Protection.
records.summary: This ordinance requires all commercial establishments in Pitogo to have working fire extinguishers and undergo annual fire safety inspections by the Bureau of Fire Protection. It applies to businesses operating within the municipality to ensure fire safety compliance.

records.title: UAT-PROBE Tricycle Franchise Ordinance
records.content: All tricycles operating in the municipality must be registered and display a franchise sticker. Section 1. No tricycle shall operate without a valid franchise sticker issued by the Municipal Transportation Office. Section 2. Violators shall pay a fine of one thousand pesos.

records.title: UAT-PROBE Tricycle Deregulation Ordinance
records.content: Tricycle operation in the municipality shall not require any registration or franchise sticker. Section 1. The requirement for tricycle franchise stickers is hereby abolished. Section 2. All tricycle operators are free to operate without municipal registration.
